notices.agenda_text:
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS 

The Eagle Mountain Planning Commission will hold public hearings on July 28, 2026, at 6:30 
p.m., or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City Council 
Chambers, located at 1650 E. Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The Planning 
Commission will receive public comments concerning the following items: 

Transportation Master Plan and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP) Update: The hearing is 
for adoption of an update to the Transportation Master Plan and Impact Fee Facilities Plan 
(IFFP) The City's Transportation Master Plan is intended to identify the needed 
transportation infrastructure needed to provide adequate service for the City's residents 
and businesses. This comprehensive transportation plan that must be developed and 
regularly maintained to combat the potential congestion caused by projected growth. This 
plan must incorporate the goals of the city of Eagle Mountain regarding the transportation 
systems within our jurisdiction and those regional facilities maintained by UDOT, UTA, Utah 
County, and neighboring communities. EMC Point of Contact: Assistant City Engineer, David 
Salazar: dsalazar@eaglemountain.gov. 

Pinnacles Master Development Plan/Master Development Agreement Zone Change: A 
request by Andy Flamm for Master Development Plan and Agreement Amendment (with an 
associated Rezone and Future Land Use Map Amendment) to change the identification and 
zoning of two parcels of land (County Assessor Acct./Serial #s 59:034:0192 & 59:034:0193) 
6.04 acres and 5.24 acres respectively, from Commercial Neighborhood to Agriculture and 
the future land use setting/category from Neighborhood Residential 1 to Ag. EMC Point of 
Contact: Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs, rhobbs@eaglemountain.gov. 

Pole Canyon Lot Split PLGA-26-9: A proposed lot split for 2333 N O St., Utah County 
Parcel Number 59:055:0011, that will create two lots of approximately ten acres each. 
EMC Point of Contact: Planner, Mickie Mills: mmills@eaglemountain.gov. 

Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Amendments:  

EMMC 17.60.120.C - Barbed Wire Fencing: A proposed amendment to Eagle Mountain 
Code section 17.60.120.C to allow barbed wire fencing in the RTI Overlay Zone and clarify 
that chain link fencing, where allowed, shall not be topped with barbed wire. EMC Point of 
Contact: Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs: rhobbs@eaglemountain.gov. 

EMMC 17.25.040A - Residential Standards Table: proposed amendment to Eagle 
Mountain Code Section 17.25.040, Residential Standards Table, to acknowledge existing 
lots smaller than 4,500 square feet that are rezoned to the RC Zone as legally 
nonconforming; likewise, for existing building setbacks that are smaller than the minimum 
setbacks otherwise required in the RC Zone. EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, Robert 
Hobbs: rhobbs@eaglemountain.gov. 

EMMC 17.100.040 - Master Site Plans: A proposed amendment to Eagle Mountain Code 
Section 17.100.040 (Master Site Plans) to clarify when a master site plan or standard site 
plan is required, establish the applicable review process, require a separate plat application 
for land proposed to be subdivided within a site plan, and require approval of a master site 
plan before approval of a plat for land proposed to be subdivided within that plan's area. 
EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs: rhobbs@eaglemountain.gov. 

EMMC 16.20.040 - Preliminary Plats: Regarding street names on preliminary plats. EMC 
Point of Contact: Senior Planner, David Stroud: dstroud@eaglemountain.gov. 

EMMC 16.25.040 - Final Plats: Regarding street names and City maintained property on 
final plats. EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, David Stroud: 
dstroud@eaglemountain.gov. 

Materials for the public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on 
the city website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, 
Eagle Mountain, UT, during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 
5:30 PM. If you need special accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the 
City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611.  Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at 
www.eaglemountain.gov. 
THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN ALL PUBLIC MEETINGS.

EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS 

The Eagle Mountain Planning Commission will hold public hearings on June 23, 2026, at 6:30 p.m., 
or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City Council Chambers, located at 
1650 E. Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The Planning Commission will receive public 
comments concerning the following items: 

Triumph Master Development Agreement Amendment: A request by Scot Hazard for Master 
Development Agreement Amendment approval pertaining to Triumph Subdivision in order to allow 
for the creation of four (4) affordable housing 'pods' within the development. The proposed pods 
range from 2.8 - 4.5 acres in size and are intended to have higher residential densities than the 
balance of the project. Triumph Subdivision is located in Section 19, T6S, R1W, on the east and west 
sides of N. Lake Mountain Road south of E. Pole Canyon Blvd. (County Assessor Parcel/Serial # 
59:019:0031) in Eagle Mountain City; application set identified as the: 'Triumph Master Development 
Agreement Amendment'. EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, Robert Hobbs: 
rhobbs@eaglemountain.gov. 

Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Amendments:  

EMMC Chapter 16.20, 16.25, and 17.100 - Cost Estimate Code Amendment: Consideration of an 
amendment to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapters 16.20, 16.25, and 17.100, Application 
Requirements, Cost Estimates. EMC Point of Contact: Community Development Director, Brandon 
Larsen: blarsen@eaglemountain.gov.   

EMMC 17.10.030, 17.80.120, and 17.80.160 - Seasonal and Political Signs: This proposed code 
amendment provides definitions for park strips and political signs, updates standards and practices 
for political signs, and updates standards for temporary and seasonal use signs. EMC Point of 
Contact: Planner, Steven Lehmitz: slehmitz@eaglemountain.gov. 

EMMC 17.75.052 - Accessory Recreation Buildings: This proposed code amendment establishes 
special use standards for recreation buildings that are an accessory use to religious or cultural 
meeting halls. EMC Point of Contact: Planner, Steven Lehmitz: slehmitz@eaglemountain.gov. 

Materials for the public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on the city 
website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, 
UT, during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. If you need special 
accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611.  
Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at www.eaglemountain.gov. 

THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN ALL PUBLIC MEETINGS. 

Published June 10, 2026

EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS 

The Eagle Mountain Planning Commission will hold a hearing for affected entities on June 9, 
2026, at 6:30 p.m., or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City 
Council Chambers, located at 1650 E. Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The 
Planning Commission will receive comments concerning the following item: 
Annexation Policy Plan: Eagle Mountain City is proposing an updated annexation 
policy plan and is seeking feedback from affected entities, as defined in §10-2-801 of 
the Utah Code Annotated - including special districts or special service districts 
whose boundary includes any part of an area proposed for annexation; a school 
district whose boundary includes any part of an area proposed for annexation, if the 
boundary is proposed to be adjusted as a result of the annexation; and a municipality 
whose boundaries are within 1/2 mile of an area proposed for annexation. This is a 
public meeting in which the City is seeking feedback from affected entities at this 
point of the proposed annexation policy plan update process. Affected entities will 
also have ten (10) additional days, after the public meeting, to submit written 
feedback to the Planning Commission for consideration. EMC Point of Contact: 
Community Development Director, Brandon Larsen: blarsen@eaglemountain.gov. 

Materials for the public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on the city 
website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, 
UT, during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. If you need special 
accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611.  
Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at www.eaglemountain.gov. 
AFFECTED ENTITIES ARE INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING.

7.A. PUBLIC HEARING / ACTION ITEM - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, 
amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.10.030 Definitions, 17.25.030 
Land Use Table, and enacting Chapter 17.55 Senior Housing Overlay Zone.  
BACKGROUND: (Presented by Housing Coordinator, Kiara Polee, and Long Range 
Planner, Elizabeth Fewkes) The City Council directed staff to create an overlay zone in 
an effort to encourage the construction of senior housing in the City. 
7.B. PUBLIC HEARING:  An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the General 
Plan Future Land use Map for Annexation Policy.   
BACKGROUND: (Presented by Community Development Director, Brandon Larsen) 
 Eagle Mountain City is proposing an updated annexation policy plan and is seeking 
feedback from affected entities, as defined in §10-2-801 of the Utah Code Annotated - 
including special districts or special service districts whose boundary includes any part 
of an area proposed for annexation; a school district whose boundary includes any part 
of an area proposed for annexation, if the boundary is proposed to be adjusted as a 
result of the annexation; and a municipality whose boundaries are within 1/2 mile of an 
area proposed for annexation. This is a public meeting in which the City is seeking 
feedback from affected entities at this point of the proposed annexation policy plan 
update process. Affected entities will also have ten (10) additional days, after the public 
meeting, to submit written feedback to the Planning Commission for consideration. 
7.C. PUBLIC HEARING / ACTION ITEM: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, 
Approving the Second Amendment to the Eagle Quest East Master Development 
Agreement.   
BACKGROUND: (Presented by Planner, Steven Lehmitz) Planning Commission 
recommendation on a proposed second amendment to the Eagle Quest East Master 
Development Agreement that would extend the initial benchmarks of development and 
the overall expiration of the Agreement. The project is located on Parcel No. 
59:006:0053, which is just north of the Sunset Flats development. 
7.D. PUBLIC HEARING / ACTION ITEM - Consolidated Fee Schedule Amendment 
BACKGROUND: (Presented by Community Development Director, Brandon Larsen) 
Planning Commission review and recommendation of a proposed amendment to the 
City's Consolidated Fee Schedule Section 13 - Building Department Fees, 10.7 Other 
Subdivision Development Fees and Appendix B Building Valuation Table.
